sources.title: allenai/olmo-3-7b-think • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Custom model by allenai Olmo3 7B Think by AllenAI AllenAI introduces Olmo 3, a new family of 7B and 32B models. This suite includes Base, Instruct, and Think variants. The Base models were trained using a staged training approach. Olmo is a series of Open language models designed to enable the science of language models. These models are trained on the Dolma 3 dataset. All code, checkpoints ...

sources.title: Olmo-3-7B-Think: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The 3.1 32B instruction model likely outperforms this 7B thinking model on chat and general QA tasks, but the 7B-Think will outperform on math and coding due to explicit reasoning. Technical specifications Olmo-3-7B-Think is a Transformer-based causal language model with 7 billion parameters trained on the Dolma 3 dataset.
